import asyncio

WIDTH = 1


# CASE helper_items_op_width expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency(items, operation, width):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(
            *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])
        )


# CASE call_items_op_one expect=fire
async def call_items_op_one(items, save):
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, 1)


# CASE call_items_op_min_one expect=fire
async def call_items_op_min_one(items, save, n):
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, min(1, n))


# CASE call_items_op_local_one expect=fire
async def call_items_op_local_one(items, save):
    width = 1
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, width)


# CASE call_items_op_four expect=pass
async def call_items_op_four(items, save):
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, 4)


# CASE call_reassigned expect=pass
async def call_reassigned(items, save, n):
    width = 1
    width = n
    await map_with_concurrency(items, width, save)


# CASE call_branch_one expect=pass
async def call_branch_one(items, save, debug):
    width = 4
    if debug:
        width = 1
    await map_with_concurrency(items, width, save)


# CASE call_param_shadows_module expect=pass
async def call_param_shadows_module(items, save, WIDTH=4):
    await map_with_concurrency(items, WIDTH, save)


# CASE call_loop_var expect=pass
async def call_loop_var(items, save):
    for width in (2, 4, 8):
        await map_with_concurrency(items, width, save)


# CASE call_keyword_op_first expect=fire
async def call_keyword_op_first(items, save):
    await map_with_concurrency(operation=save, items=items, width=1)


# CASE call_min_len_items expect=pass
async def call_min_len_items(items, save):
    await map_with_concurrency(items, min(8, len(items)), save)


# CASE call_min_one_len expect=fire
async def call_min_one_len(items, save):
    await map_with_concurrency(items, min(1, len(items)), save)
